about: Who the outer road's people and animals are and what they do: every painted figure and animal of S4 part 1 (map/text/S4.md, u 9400-12600) at its mapped spot (layout.json), and nobody else (map/BUILDING.md). Written by gen/sections/outer_road/make_people.py (the casting of gen/expand/outer_road_needs.md and the lead's calls of 2026-10-12); rerun it when the workshop delivers characters, clips and props. figures: character (a new one plays its stand_in until it exists), do = [clip, seconds] cycles with clips the playing character has (clips_why: what is still to make), nudge = [dX, dD] (nudge_why), facing_deg where the map gives none (facing_why), scale for children (scale_why), ride = the animal a rider sits on, props = carried prop_<name> parts (props_why). walkers: figures painted mid-stride or carrying a load, walking along their painted direction from their spot and back (walkers_why). animals: each painted animal at its map position facing hind to fore, model and load from web/public/assets/animals/animals.json (horse_white, bird and the pannier_charcoal load are being made: the page skips them until then). No traffic.

clips_why.about: Actions the painting needs that the playing character lacks. "being made": the workshop has it in the character's characters/<name>.json; "to make": nobody has it for that character yet (NEW: a new action; otherwise a retarget of an existing motion). Rerun make_people.py when they land; until then each figure plays the nearest clip its character, or stand-in, has.
